XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Unintentional shifting into neutral, gearbox lock in the last gear engaged during acceleration.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | CLUTCH | P2917 | P060A | NEUTRAL | GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | GEARS | ACCELERATING | ACCELERATION | BOTTOM | LIGHTS UP | IGNITION | LIGHTED | WARNING LIGHT | GEAR | RED | RED |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles fitted with a robotised gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Component: Clutch

  • Fault: During sudden deceleration, the gearbox shifts into neutral automatically. When accelerating, it may lock in the last gear engaged. Restarting the engine temporarily restores normal operation. The gearbox fault warning light comes on sporadically.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P2917 (Gear engagement/disengagement actuator – stuck)
    • P060A (Injection control unit – processor module)
  • Cause: Worn clutch

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the clutch and replace it if necessary.
